# Texas Cemetery Brokers

> Cemetery brokerage helping Texas families buy and sell cemetery plots, mausoleum crypts, and burial spaces across Dallas, Houston, Austin, and San Antonio. Operated in partnership with Bayer Cemetery Brokers — a licensed California brokerage (CEB 1512) with 30+ years of experience and 9,000+ transactions. Save 30–50% versus retail cemetery prices.

## Services
- [Buy Cemetery Plots in Texas](/buy): Browse discounted cemetery plots, niches, and crypts across Texas.
- [Sell a Cemetery Plot in Texas](/sell): Free valuation, no upfront fees, 30–60 day close.
- [Property Types](/property-types): Guide to burial plots, crypts, niches, and family estates.
